summary: Treat each same-color 4-connected component as an object. Two objects are neighbors exactly when their one-step orthogonal dilations overlap, equivalently when the minimum Manhattan distance between their cells is at most two. Recolor every cell of each object by its neighbor degree: 0->2, 1->3, 2->8, 3->6, and 4 or more->9; leave background black.
